name: Helix Systems demo benchmark
description: Hand-written questions over four fictional Helix Systems policy documents. Expected answers and relevant documents were labelled manually from the source text. Includes unanswerable questions to test abstention.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
questions.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accruing at 2 days per month.

questions.question: How many casual leaves are allowed per year?
questions.expected_answer: Employees receive 8 days of casual leave per calendar year, which cannot be carried forward.

questions.question: How much unused annual leave can be carried forward and when does it expire?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 10 days of unused annual leave can be carried forward; it expires if not used by 31 March of the following year.

questions.question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
questions.expected_answer: A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days.

questions.question: How long is paternity leave for non-birthing parents?
questions.expected_answer: Non-birthing parents get 4 weeks of paid paternity leave, taken within 6 months of birth or adoption.

questions.question: What is the notice period for managers after confirmation?
questions.expected_answer: The notice period is 90 days for managers and above.

questions.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
questions.expected_answer: New employees serve a probation period of 6 months, which can be extended once by up to 3 months.

questions.question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
questions.expected_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length for company accounts?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

questions.question: Within how much time must a lost laptop be reported?
questions.expected_answer: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT Service Desk within 1 hour of discovery.

questions.question: How quickly must a suspected phishing email be reported and to whom?
questions.expected_answer: Suspected security incidents including phishing must be reported to security@helix.example within 30 minutes.

questions.question: Which systems require multi-factor authentication?
questions.expected_answer: MFA is mandatory for email, VPN, source-code repositories and all cloud consoles.

questions.question: What is the daily meal allowance for international travel?
questions.expected_answer: The daily meal allowance for international travel is USD 75.

questions.question: When is business class allowed on flights?
questions.expected_answer: Business class is permitted only for international flights longer than 8 hours with vice president approval.

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting expense claims?
questions.expected_answer: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days; claims after 60 days are not reimbursed.

questions.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for a personal car?
questions.expected_answer: Personal car use is reimbursed at INR 12 per kilometre.

questions.question: How many approving reviews does a pull request need?
questions.expected_answer: Every pull request needs at least two approving reviews, one from a code owner.

questions.question: On which days and times are production deployments allowed?
questions.expected_answer: Deployments are allowed Monday to Thursday between 10:00 and 17:00 IST.

questions.question: How fast must the on-call engineer acknowledge a page?
questions.expected_answer: The on-call engineer must acknowledge a page within 10 minutes.

questions.question: What is the annual learning budget for engineers?
questions.expected_answer: Each engineer has an annual learning budget of INR 50,000.
